The present writ petition along with ten other writ petitions, which are on board, have been preferred by the farmers of Bhadrak district challenging the arbitrary action and unreasonable delay of the State authorities in not releasing the cost of the collected paddy through the Opposite Party No.9 Society in the financial year 2022.
2. Since the issue involved in the present writ petition so also other connected matters, which are on board, are same, all are being taken up for hearing and final disposal together.
3. The brief background facts, which led to filing of the writ petitions are that the present Petitioners, who are Farmers of Basudevpur Block, cultivated their agricultural land and harvested paddy.

In the financial year 2022, as per the policy for paddy procurement of the State Government,
token numbers were provided to them for procurement of paddy.
The Petitioners' Farmer Code Number so also Bank Account Number were linked for payment of cost of the procured paddy directly to their Bank Accounts.

All of them received messages for supply of paddy and deposited the paddy with the Collecting Agent i.e. Gaddy Co-operative Society Limited, Basudevpur, on 28.02.2023 and the cost of paddy to them was fixed @ Rs.2040/- per Quintal.

4. The Petitioners awaited for receiving the cost of the paddy and verified their Account Statements from time to time, as the Secretary of the Gaddy Society Co-operative Ltd, which is the procurement Agent, informed the Petitioners that the cost of the paddy will be paid to the Farmer's Linked account directly.

However, as there was no transfer of the paddy price to their respective bank Accounts, the Petitioners along with the villagers submitted their grievance petition before the Gouranga Swain vs State Of Odisha & on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152646646/
3 Collector, Bhadrak for necessary enquiry and to take steps for release of the cost of the paddy procured from the Farmers by the Gaddy Co- operative Society Limited.

sentences.text: Though the grievance petition has been submitted since 06.09.2023, no action has been taken by the Collector, Bhadrak till date.
5. It is further case of the Petitioners that similar representations were also submitted before the C.S.O., Bhadrak, S.P. Bhadrak, A.R.C.S., Bhadrak and I.I.C. Kasia Marine Police Station.

On intervention of the I.I.C., Kasia Marine Police Station, the Secretary of Gaddy Co-operative Society Limited (O.P.No.9) assured the Petitioners that the payment of the paddy price will be made very soon.
He also paid a sum of Rs.2,00,000/- in the Police Station for distribution among the 12 Farmers towards part payment of the cost of the paddy, which was distributed amongst the Petitioners.

6. Though the Secretary of the Society assured the Petitioners to disburse the remaining cost of the paddy within October, 2023, but till date no payment has been made, for which the Petitioners were being constrained to approach this Court seeking for a direction to the Opposite Parties to disburse the remaining cost of the paddy procured from them.
7.
Reiterating the facts detailed above, learned Counsel for the Petitioners prayed for a direction to the Opposite Parties to ensure release of the remaining cost of paddy in favour of the Petitioner.
8. Being noticed, the Opposite Party-Corporation has filed a detailed Counter Affidavit.

Apart from detailing the procedure to procure the paddy and make the payment to the farmers as per the policy of the State Government, Mr. Sharma, learned Counsel for the Opposite Party- Corporation,
drawing attention of this Court to the Joint Verification Report relating to paddy procurement of Gaddy Co-operative Society Ltd under Basudevpur Block, held on 04.04.2023, which has been annexed to the Counter Affidavit as Annexure-D/7, submitted that as per the direction of Collector,
Bhadrak, all the signatories have visited to the Gaddy SCS on 04.04.2023 to discuss the issue.
As per the said Report, the Enquiry was conducted by CS Officials and Co-operative Officials pertaining to the paddy procurement operation of Gaddy CS Ltd under Basudevpur Block on 04.04.2023.
The team reported that the Purchase Officer and other subordinates of the Gaddy CS Ltd have committed negligence in duty and irregularities with malafide intention.
As such, the team has recommended to take stringent action against the erring officials.

The President, Gaddy CS Ltd has placed Sri Banamali Mahakud, the Secretary Gaddy CS Ltd, under suspension vide Order dated 10.04.2023.
9.

Mr. Sharma, learned Counsel further submitted that pursuant to the Office Order dated 21.04.2023 of the Collector, Bhadrak, Sri Tapas Kumar Rout, the Supervisory Officer of Gaddy CS Ltd was also placed under suspension for lack of supervision in paddy procurement operation at Gaddy Co-operative Society Ltd.
Besides, Sri Basanta Kumar Biswal, working as Data Entry Operator, was also kept away from the Gaddy SCS.

In addition to the same, pursuant to the direction of the Collector, Bhadrak vide letter dated 11.04.2023, an FIR was lodged against Sri Banamali Mahakud, the Purchase Officer of Gaddy SCS in the Marine P.S., Kasia, Bhadrak vide Marine P.S. Case No.46 dated 15.05.2023 under section 403/420 IPC.

sentences.text:
Mr. Sharma further submitted, the Purchase Officer of the Gaddy CS Ltd has misappropriated the paddy of the farmers by violating terms & conditions of the paddy procurement operation and clause 6 (E) III & 6 (J) IV of the triparty agreement executed on 28.12.2022 between Banamali Mahakud, Secretary Gaddy SCS, ARCS, Bhadrak and the District Manager, OSCSC Ltd., Bhadrak.
11.

On being noticed, the Opposite Party No.9 i.e. Secretary, Gaddy Co-operative Society Ltd. has appeared and filed his Counter Affidavit admitting therein the grievance of the Petitioners as to non-payment of their dues towards procuring their paddy.

However, a plea has been taken in the Counter Affidavit that the acceptance note could not be prepared before 31.03.2023 for non cooperation by the Millers namely, Durga Rice Mill, Radhakantapur, Symbol Foods and Symbol Agro under Basudevpur tahasil, Bhadrak district for which the Secretary of the Society made a complaint before the Collector, Bhadrak.

Meeting was convened before the Collector in presence of Millers, Civil Supplies Officer and the Secretary, Gaddy Co-operative Society Ltd and A.R.C.S.
regarding payment of price of paddy procured in April & May, 2023.
12. Thereafter, on intervention of the Collector, Durga Rice Mill released the price of the paddy in a phased manner manually instead of online payment to the account of farmers.
As the payment to farmers directly is a difficult task for the Miller, as per advice of the Collector, the same has been paid through Gaddy Society.

The Miller paid the amount in installments and the Secretary of the Society disbursed the said amount to the Petitioners/Farmers in a phased manner and an amount of Rs.7,92,561.80/- has already been paid to the Petitioners.

Apart from that, in Para-9 of the Counter Affidavit, it has been undertaken by the deponent, who is the Secretary of the Gaddy Co- operative Society Ltd, that the remaining amount of price of paddy procured from the present Petitioners will be paid to them within two months i.e. on or before end of May, 2024.
Paragraph-9 of the said Counter Affidavit

, being relevant, is extracted below for ready reference:-
"9. That in view of the factual procedure without submitting parawise reply to the Writ Petition, the deponent submits that he being the Secretary of the Society, he is taking careful and needful action for early payment of aforesaid balance amount to the farmers.
The delay in causing payment is not attributable to the Secretary but due to technical process.
Dispute raised by the miller with regard to weight calculation is the cause of delay.
This deponent is taking effective steps to pay all the balance amount reflected in aforesaid Table to 11 farmers within two months.
As per official records only present eleven farmers are yet to received part of the paddy amount.
The deponent will pay the same within two months on or before end of May, 2024."

(Emphasis Supplied)
13. Reiterating the stand taken in the Counter Affidavit, learned Counsel for the Opposite Party No.9 submitted that the delay in payment to the Petitioners- Farmers is because of the reasons detailed in the Counter Affidavit.

sentences.text: In view of the undertaking given by the Opposite Party No.9, as detailed above, who is the Secretary of Gaddy Co-operative Society Limited, all the writ petitions stand disposed of vide this common order directing the Opposite Party No.9 to act in terms of his undertaking, as detailed above, and make the payment to the Petitioners the remaining amount towards paddy procurement on or before May, 2024.

15. Needless to mention here that even if the Secretary of Gaddy Co-operative Society Limited has been placed under suspension, as detailed in the Counter Affidavit filed by the Corporation, the Opposite Parties are directed to cooperate with the Opposite Party No.9 to act in terms of the undertaking given by him before this Court and to ensure the payment of remaining cost of paddy to the Petitioners/Farmers on or before May, 2024.
16. With the said observation and direction, all the writ petitions stand disposed of.
17. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application as per rules.
